newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia stock to be delisted.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia stock to be delisted.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said Tuesday its Class A common stock would be delisted from the Nasdaq National Market.
The shares will be officially delisted after trading today, the company said.
MobileMedia offers paging and personal communications services.

The company, which filed for bankruptcy in January, said it has determined, and its independent auditors agree, that it may be required to write down the carrying value of its long-lived assets to their fair value.
The amount of the writedown could be material but it is not possible to determine its amount at this time, the company said.

Because MobileMedia cannot issue audited financial statements in compliance with generally accepted accounting principles, it said it will not file its report on Form 10-K or its other periodic reports and will seek the delisting.
